description: This file implements the PollingProxyConfigService class, which manages proxy configuration updates via polling, including thread-safe operations, observer notifications, and asynchronous configuration retrieval.

classes.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core
classes.description: A reference-counted internal class that handles the core logic of polling, configuration retrieval, and observer notification, running on a dedicated thread.

methods.name: Core
methods.description: Constructor initializing polling interval, configuration fetch function, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: Orphan
methods.description: Called when the parent service is destroyed to prevent further callbacks.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the latest proxy configuration if available.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of configuration changes.

methods.name: OnLazyPoll
methods.description: Checks if enough time has passed to perform a new poll.

methods.name: PollAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous polling to fetch configuration.

methods.name: GetConfigCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of configuration fetch and notifies observers if changed.

methods.name: LazyInitializeOriginLoop
methods.description: Initializes the thread context for callbacks.
